manioc_kosheni_traitement_001 : NE PAS PUBLIER la 3e phrase (mélange huile+eau) sans dosage, émulsifiant et validation agronomique
manioc_kosheni_symptomes_001 : 'tomitomi jɛmanw' (taches blanches) à confirmer localement

corrections.manioc_irrigation_001: Banankuuu bɛ jitanya muɲu ka ɲɛ. A bɛ se ka to kalo saba sanjiii tɛ. Ni jitanya ka mɛn, ji dɔɔni bɛ a dɛmɛ.
corrections.manioc_engrais_001: Banankuuu tɛ nɔgɔ caman fɛ. Sɛnɛ tuma, aw ye NPK dɔɔni don dugukoloo la. Dugukolo ɲuman na, banankuuu bɛ bɔ hali nɔgɔ tɛ.
corrections.manioc_stockage_001: Banankuuu kura bɛ cɛn tile fila walima saba kɔnɔ. Ka a mara, aw ye a ja walima gari kɛ. Banankuuu jalen bɛ se ka to kalo caman.
corrections.manioc_vente_001: Banankuuu fere ka ɲi gari walima mugu ye. Aw ye a fere kura walima a yɛlɛma ka sɔngɔ bonya. Lɔgɔ bɛ banankuuu saniyalen ani sugandilen fɛ.
corrections.manioc_diagnostic_001: Mozayiki ye banankuuu ka bana jugu bɛɛ ye; a bɛ furaw nɛrɛmuguya ka u kuru. Ni furaw kuru ka nɛrɛmuguya, aw ye yiri bananenw bɔ joona. Aw ye TMS walima IITA siya fasanw sɛnɛ.
corrections.manioc_kosheni_symptomes_001: Ni tomitomi jɛmanw bɛ banankuuu furaw kɔrɔ, kosheni bɛ a la. Kosheni bɛ furaw fɔsɔn ka yiri halaki joona. Aw ye yiri bananenw bɔ, ka furakɛli kɛ joona.
corrections.manioc_kosheni_traitement_001: Aw ye banankuuu bananenw bɔ foroo la ka u mabɔ. O kɔ, aw ye sosofagalan kɛ yiri tɔw la. Ni sosofagalan tɛ, tulu ni ji ɲagami bɛ se ka dɛmɛ.
corrections.manioc_kosheni_prevention_001: Ka banankuuu kisi kosheni ma, aw ye duguturu kɛnɛmanw dɔrɔn sɛnɛ. Kalo o kalo, aw ye foroo kɔrɔsi. Ni aw ye kosheni tagamasiɲɛ fɔlɔw ye, aw ye yiri bananenw bɔ joona.
